main_measure.name: mean unusual 6-bar move of long bets (return minus coin's mean 6-bar return)
main_measure.threshold: confirm: mean > 0 with t >= 2 and check passes; reject: mean < 0 with t <= -2; fewer than 30 cases inconclusive

supporting_check.name: correlation of signal forecast with unusual move > 0

decided_by: Mean unusual move above 0 with t >= 2 and a positive forecast/move correlation (confirm rule).
reading: Situation = regime 'mean_reversion' (volume band) with raw dip_in_rise > 0, a falling close and a positive 168-bar return where computable in the window, on a positive forecast; a case is the first bet (forecast rise >= 2 from its lowest long level since the last bet) in each 6-bar grid cell from each window's first row; drift is the coin's mean 6-bar grid return over all its windows; the plan's 'fewer than 30 cases' is treated as the minimum count giving 'not observable'.

direction_check.why: main measure +0.0007379 on the check folds against +0.001075 on every fold
